description:
Renewals and closing opposition windows for this user.

    `kind` matters and should be relayed honestly: `opposition` carries a real date;
    `window_pending` means a filing is still in examination and nothing is running
    yet; `window_unknown` means a live threat whose clock we cannot date — treat that
    as urgent; `window_closed` means opposition is gone and the route is cancellation.
name: my_deadlines
title: My upcoming deadlines
